uncited: It solves the problem of joint camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction by optimizing neural network parameters and camera poses simultaneously using photometric and geometric constraints, differing from explicit point-based siblings like Gaussian Splatting by requiring ray marching for rendering .
The family relies on a neural network $F$ that maps spatial coordinates $\mathbf{x}$ to scene properties.
For appearance, $F$ outputs color $\mathbf{c}$ and volume density $\sigma$ (or occupancy) .

Rendering is performed via volume rendering or ray marching: points are sampled along camera rays, properties are predicted by $F$, and results are aggregated using alpha compositing or weighted sums .
Optimization jointly updates the network weights and camera poses $T_t$ to minimize photometric ($\ell_{rgb}$) and geometric ($\ell_{depth}$ or SDF) losses .
